name: pathObjectName
label: Object Name
help: The API name of an object, e.g. `company`, `person`, `opportunity`, or a custom object's API name.

name: queryValidationMode
label: Validation Mode
help: Validation mode for request data.  - `strict`: Reject requests if any attribute is invalid or unrecognized. - `ignore_invalid`: Ignore unknown attributes and omit invalid values for optional attributes. Reject requests with an invalid body structure or invalid required attributes.

name: requestBody
label: Request Body (JSON)
help: Enter the complete JSON request body for update_object_record. Preserve JSON types. See docs/operation-contracts.json and the Unify API reference.
